retrievalProfile.description: A surrealist rural scene featuring an impossibly large agricultural subject on a horse-drawn wagon, framed by classic serif typography and a grainy vintage print texture.
triggerTerms: halftone print texture with serif headers
excludeWhen: urban or futuristic themes are needed

recipe.visualDefinition: A composite image blending a grainy, desaturated vintage photograph of a farm family and horse-drawn carriage with a disproportionately massive, oversized watermelon. The scene is set against a flat, golden-hued field and a pale blue sky, framed by large, elegant serif text at the top and bottom.
coreVisualRelationships: Scale contrast between the tiny human figures and the massive central fruit
Symmetry between the top and bottom typographic headers
Horizontal alignment of the wagon and ground plane
Color harmony between the golden field and the tan-toned bottom text
coreInvariants: Visible halftone dot pattern or paper grain

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The giant fruit occupies the central 50% of the frame, resting on a wagon that spans the width of the mid-ground.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The massive green watermelon acts as the primary focal point due to its scale and central placement.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the top header, drops to the giant fruit, follows the horizontal line of the wagon and people, and rests on the bottom header.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal negative space; the composition is densely packed with the subject and large-scale typography.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation with a warm, aged yellow cast; high value contrast between the sky and the dark wagon.
paletteRestrictions: No neon or vibrant modern pigments
Limited to earth tones and faded primary colors

characterSpecificRedesigns: None; relies on standard classical proportions
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Monochromatic font family used in two different colors to create a frame.

candidateDirections.reason: Classic serifs with high legibility and historical feel
Ubiquitous traditional serif that fits the 'unbelievable' news style

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a vintage 1940s-style colorized photograph of a farm family standing next to a horse-drawn wooden wagon in a golden wheat field under a pale sky. Place a giant, house-sized watermelon on the wagon. Apply a heavy halftone print texture and aged paper grain.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add large, all-caps serif text centered at the very top in a dark teal color, and identical large all-caps serif text centered at the very bottom in a golden-tan color.

verificationChecks: Is the texture grainy and vintage?
Are the top and bottom texts centered and all-caps?
Is the color palette muted and warm?

adjustableVariables: Type of agricultural subject (e.g., giant pumpkin, giant corn)
mustRedesign: Do not use modern sans-serif fonts
Ensure the scale of the fruit is clearly impossible
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the horse and wagon look period-accurate
Confirm the top and bottom text colors contrast with their backgrounds
recipe.reuseFormula: Vintage Photo + Impossible Scale Subject + Framing Serif Typography + Halftone Texture
